data.name: Rohan
data.gender_notes: Rohan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root ruh, 'to ascend, grow' — rohaṇa, 'ascending'. Its root is Sanskrit ruh (रुह्). A classical Sanskrit term for ascent or growth. Rohan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ascending; growing; to rise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohan expresses “Ascending; growing; to rise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root ruh, 'to ascend, grow' — rohaṇa, 'ascending'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohan total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit root रोह (roh) which is used extensively in the Vedas to describe the act of riding or journeying. It is also associated with the mythological figure Rohan, the king of the Rohan people in Middle-earth.
